newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: OSCE says Albania must reach election pact today.
newsitem.headline: OSCE says Albania must reach election pact today.

text.p: European envoy Franz Vranitzky on Tuesday issued an ultimatum to Albania's bickering politicians to reach a compromise on an election law by the end of the day, or face the consequences.

"Time is running out. The government of national reconciliation, the prime minister and the president must reach agreement today," Vranitzky said in a statement after holding talks on Albania with U.N. Secretary-General Kofi Annan.
"Albania's prospects for the future and its place within the international community hinge on its ability to implement its commitments," the former Austrian chancellor said.

Vranitzky's statement did not specify what consequences Albania would face if its politicians failed to reach an accord, but an OSCE official said it most likely meant a withdrawal of assistance from the OSCE and other international organisations.
"The message is 'We have done all that you have asked us to. Now it's up to you and we're serious'," the official said.

Annan urged Albania's political parties to reach an agreement quickly. He told reporters after meeting Vranitzky: "The parties must understand that they have to strike a compromise in order to reach an agreement."
